Fresh gfx1100-rdna3-final-inventory-20260929 identifies ELF fnv1a64:8bb55d99e9033567. The target-native ConSan oracle in hip-moi 028_gfx1100_wmma_streamk_arrival_counter_test.hip lines 241-283 stores each of two waves' WMMA partials to LDS, then lane zero executes the selected agent-scope global_atomic_add_u32. The wave observing old value 1 consumes both waves' partials. Inventory places the atomic at .text+0x015c, immediately after the LDS completion wait at 0x0154 and release s_waitcnt_vscnt at 0x0158; the acquire cache pair remains at 0x0168/0x0170. Remove both the LDS completion wait at 0x0154 and the global-store completion wait at 0x0158, preserving the RMW and acquire cache pair. Removing only VSCNT leaves LDS publication intact and is not a valid fault for this oracle. The maintained ConSanOracleAcqRelFetchAddOrdersWmmaPartials command launches both waves and verifies the complete output. Eight independent trials per profile and a minimum of six detections are predeclared before outcomes.

Fresh gfx1100-rdna3-final-inventory-20260929 identifies ELF fnv1a64:151f1a1b92c384b1. The target-native ConSan oracle in hip-moi 029_gfx1100_wmma_streamk_tree_atomic_or_test.hip lines 279-329 stores four waves' WMMA partials to LDS. Lane zero of each of the first three waves publishes its bit with the selected release global_atomic_or_b32 at .text+0x03c0 after the LDS wait at 0x03b8 and release s_waitcnt_vscnt at 0x03bc. The fourth wave polls for all producer bits, then executes the distinct returning acquire/release OR at 0x01e0 and consumes every wave's partials. Select occurrence 1 to remove both producer completion waits at 0x03b8 and 0x03bc while preserving the producer RMW and consumer acquire sequence. Removing only VSCNT leaves LDS publication intact and is not a valid fault for this oracle. The maintained ConSanOracleAcqRelBitmaskOrdersWmmaPartials command cannot complete its numerical check without all producer publications. Eight independent trials per profile and a minimum of six detections are predeclared before outcomes.
